Temporary homepage video placeholder
===================================

File: boutique-placeholder.mp4
Source: https://www.pexels.com/video/people-look-and-check-the-clothes-at-the-store-4750039/
License: https://www.pexels.com/license/

This is generic stock footage used as a temporary visual placeholder. It is
not footage of La Belle Boutique and must not be presented as such.

To replace it, overwrite boutique-placeholder.mp4 with the final MP4 while
keeping the same filename. The website will then use the new video on both
the Czech and English homepages. A short, silent 16:9 MP4 is recommended.
